title: 1RB0LE_1LC0RE_0RA0LD_1LA1LF_0LC0RE_1LE---: the stage law proved in Lean
text: The late stages of 1RB0LE_1LC0RE_0RA0LD_1LA1LF_0LC0RE_1LE--- are events of its chain law with the word Z empty, and with a chain of base-3 words on the left, where each separator passes two increments on. chain_event proves this law for every layout, and it explains the gifts that had been fitted per stage. With the proved law in place of the fitted one, the run from blank tape is followed to about 10137 events with no halt. There an item outside the grammar (a half-digit shift) stops it.
